label: TP
reason: User-controlled header value flows directly to encodeForHTML() sink without proper validation. The header name extraction (line 61) passes unvalidated user input through doSomething() which returns it unchanged (line 75, 81), gets converted to bytes and back to string (lines 128-129), then fed to ESAPI encoder. While encodeForHTML provides some protection, the data flow shows user input reaching the HTML encoding sink without effective filtering.

evidence.note: User input from header flows through doSomething() to encodeForHTML() sink
